item.title: Fixing Java Access Restriction Errors via Build Path and Compiler Settings
item.description:
“Fixing Java Access Restriction Errors via Build Path and Compiler Settings”

Encountering “Access Restriction” errors during Java compilation, often manifesting as forbidden references to classes within the JRE, presents a significant hurdle in development environments like Eclipse. This issue typically arises from conflicts between the classes provided by the system’s JRE/JDK and classes present in project libraries (JARs), potentially violating licensing agreements or due to version mismatches.

What are the most effective, expert-verified strategies for mitigating these ‘Forbidden reference (access rules)’ compiler issues?
